description: Tool to run a customized pivot report of Google Analytics event data. Use when you need a pivot table view with advanced segmentation and multi-dimensional analysis of GA4 data.

inputSchema.description: Request model for running a customized pivot report of Google Analytics event data.

cohortSpec.description: Optional. Cohort configuration with 'cohorts' (required), optional 'cohortsRange' and 'cohortReportSettings'.
cohortSpec.title: Cohort Spec

comparisons.description: Optional. Comparison configurations. Each comparison has optional 'name' and required 'dimensionFilter' or 'comparison'.
comparisons.title: Comparisons

dateRanges.description: Optional. Date ranges for event data retrieval. Each range has 'startDate' and 'endDate' (YYYY-MM-DD format or relative like 'NdaysAgo', 'yesterday', 'today'), and optional 'name'.
dateRanges.title: Date Ranges

dimensionFilter.description: Optional. Filter clause for dimensions only. Can use andGroup, orGroup, notExpression, or filter.
dimensionFilter.title: Dimension Filter

dimensions.description: Optional. Dimensions to request. Each dimension has a 'name' field and optional 'dimensionExpression'. Dimensions must be used in pivots, filters, or orderBys.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

keepEmptyRows.description: Optional. If true, includes rows where all metrics equal 0.
keepEmptyRows.title: Keep Empty Rows

metricFilter.description: Optional. Post-aggregation filter (SQL HAVING clause equivalent).
metricFilter.title: Metric Filter

metrics.description: Required. At least one metric is required. Each metric has a 'name' field, optional 'expression', and optional 'invisible' boolean.
metrics.title: Metrics

pivots.description: Optional. Visual format configuration for dimensions. Each pivot has 'fieldNames' (required string array), 'limit' (required), optional 'orderBys', 'offset', and 'metricAggregations'.
pivots.title: Pivots

property.description: Required. The GA4 property resource name. Format: properties/{property_id}
property.title: Property

returnPropertyQuota.description: Optional. If true, returns current quota state in PropertyQuota.
returnPropertyQuota.title: Return Property Quota

inputSchema.title: RunPivotReportRequest

name: run_pivot_report

aggregates.description: Aggregated metric data (totals, minimums, or maximums) controlled by metricAggregations in pivot request.
aggregates.title: Aggregates

dimensionHeaders.description: Describes dimension columns; count and order align with dimensions in rows.
dimensionHeaders.title: Dimension Headers

metadata.description: Report metadata information including currency codes, time zone, and data freshness.
metadata.title: Metadata

metricHeaders.description: Describes metric columns; count and order align with metrics in rows.
metricHeaders.title: Metric Headers

pivotHeaders.description: Summarizes columns and rows created by pivots. Each PivotHeader has 'pivotDimensionHeaders' and 'rowCount'.
pivotHeaders.title: Pivot Headers

propertyQuota.description: Google Analytics property's quota state including this request. Contains token and concurrent request limits.
propertyQuota.title: Property Quota

rows.description: Contains dimension value combinations paired with corresponding metric values.
rows.title: Rows
